value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper proves only a quadratic converse in general dimensions and shows that the quadratic exponent is globally sharp. The proposed family is a canonical class of orthogonal-corner mesh elements, in which the best possible exponent improves to one; the full sharp constant and equality/degeneration classification for every dimension, the angular ranking, and \(\mathcal C_n\sim n2^{n/2}\) quantify the gain. This is a motivated structural refinement, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
